description: Capture a screenshot of one public web page as an image (JPEG) plus metadata. When to use: visual layout matters - a dashboard, chart, UI state, or 'what does this page look like'. Do not use: to read text (use web_fetch), for pages behind a login or paywall, or for bulk capture. Returns: image content (image/jpeg) plus {url, final_url, title, width, height, bytes, engine, elapsed_ms, _metering}. Rendered by a real Chromium browser, robots.txt-respecting, SSRF-guarded, max 3MB per image. Metered: shares the web free bucket (50 calls/day per IP together with web_fetch), then 2 credits per call over x402 - there is no API key; the 402 answer carries accepts[].

full_page.description: Capture the whole page instead of the viewport. Default false.

url.description: The http(s) URL to capture (max 2048 chars).

name: web_screenshot
title: Web Screenshot
